class.name: InputMapSettingsEventRow
class.brief_description: One event as a row of the CSV file of [InputMapSettingsServer].
class.description: The CSV form of one [InputMapSettingsEvent] with the name and deadzone of its action: the columns [code skip-lint]action[/code], [code skip-lint]index[/code], [code skip-lint]device[/code], [code skip-lint]input[/code], [code skip-lint]direction[/code], [code skip-lint]modifiers[/code], [code skip-lint]key_mode[/code], [code skip-lint]device_id[/code] and [code skip-lint]deadzone[/code]. [InputMapSettingsServer] converts between [InputActions] and these rows when it saves and loads; games do not need this class.

members.member: The name of the action. Column [code skip-lint]action[/code].
The deadzone of the action, the same in every row of the action. Column [code skip-lint]deadzone[/code].
The position of the event in its action, [code]-1[/code] for an action without events. Column [code skip-lint]index[/code].
See [member InputMapSettingsEvent.input]. Empty in the row of an action without events. Column [code skip-lint]input[/code].
